title: ScheduleCost
description: The cost summary a planned schedule prints before any spend: `plan.cost` in the `cowork-harness eval --dry-run --output-format json` and `hillclimb run --dry-run --output-format json` envelopes (SPEC §11, §12). A covered surface of the compatibility contract: the nine keys below — their names, types and meanings — are stable. Every dollar figure is on ONE basis: each scenario's prior runs in the runs dir's index on the schedule's effective tier and baseline, turn 1 only, `hillclimb:`-labelled runs excluded, agent cost (`costUsd`) only — judge and LLM-decider spend are not in it. Each figure sums over the PRICED scenarios; a scenario with no priced run on that basis adds $0 to every figure and is named in `unpriced`, and `lowerBound` is then true. None of the figures is a bound. This schema is deliberately permissive (no `additionalProperties: false`): the object carries EXPERIMENTAL keys beside these (`budgetGateWorstUsd`, `judgeMeanUsd`, `judgeP50Usd`, `deciderMeanUsd`, `deciderP50Usd`, `items[]`) that may change in any minor release.

jobs.description: Agent runs scheduled, over every scenario, priced or not (an eval: 2 arms x --reps per scenario).

meanUsd.description: Sum over the priced scenarios of jobs x that scenario's mean per-run cost.

p50Usd.description: Sum over the priced scenarios of jobs x that scenario's median per-run cost (the floor-index percentile `stats` prints).

p95Usd.description: Sum over the priced scenarios of jobs x that scenario's p95 per-run cost (floor index: the max run when a scenario has 20 or fewer). Pessimistic, not a bound.

worstObservedUsd.description: Sum over the priced scenarios of jobs x the single most expensive run on the basis above — every run at the worst seen. Not a bound, and NOT the `--max-budget-usd` gate's figure, which reads a wider basis (any tier, baseline or turn, hillclimb runs included).

lowerBound.description: True when at least one scenario is unpriced, so every dollar figure leaves it out.

unpriced.description: The scenarios with no priced run on the basis above; each contributed $0.

pricedRuns.description: Priced runs behind the figures, summed over the priced scenarios.

thinnest.description: The priced run count of the scenario with the fewest; null when no scenario is priced.
